# Aleka Melese Ayalew - Researcher Profile

## Bio
Aleka Melese Ayalew is a Doctoral Researcher at the Center for Machine Vision and Signal Analysis (CMVS) within the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering at the University of Oulu. She holds an MSc in Information Technology and brings over six years of professional experience as a university lecturer and educational quality assurance coordinator.

## Research Description
Her work focuses on applying large language models (LLMs) to address challenges in healthcare through "automating data processing, reducing administrative workload, providing real-time predictive analytics" and keeping practitioners informed about recent medical developments.

## Research Interests
- Artificial Intelligence
- Natural Language Processing
- Computer Vision
- Medical Image Processing

## Publications & Academic Impact
She has authored over 24 peer-reviewed articles and served as a reviewer for more than 60 articles across 15+ publications, conferences, and workshops. Her reviewing experience includes contributions to the International Conference on Electrical, Computer, and Energy Technologies (ICECET) and NeurIPS-organized workshops.

## Professional Activities
Beyond research, she demonstrates commitment to scholarly excellence through active participation in journal and conference peer review processes, reflecting engagement in fostering innovation within the academic community.
